verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents continuous daily monitoring of compliance status, with alerts and proactive admin email notifications for failing tests. Tests run against 100+ integrated tools, and data pushed via API or CSV is also tested. Failing tests surface in a centralized attention view, which delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: documented intra-day or hourly test cadence (only 'daily' is stated), detail on the test catalogue per integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing pages.
